c100.what: 100 pF / 30 kV, class 1 HV ceramic (or film)

c100h.what: 100 pF / 40 kV, class 1 HV ceramic (or film)

interfaces.interface: Ca's plates: node 1 <-> node 2 (and Cb: 4 <-> 3), the 6 mm gap
interfaces.note: 13.2 kV DC across 6 mm of air, as the vanes hold V_op: 1.5 to breakdown (the record's air margin)

interfaces.interface: the vanes: node 1 <-> REF, the 6 mm gap
interfaces.note: the varicap's own gap, as the record

interfaces.interface: the column's node-2 plate <-> the can's end disc (REF)
the column's node-2 plate <-> the deck's parts (their potted outer face)
interfaces.note: sets the column's place; the parts' bodies sit 8 mm deeper still

interfaces.interface: node 1's riser in the column's bore <-> the node-2 plates' inner rims
interfaces.note: PTFE HV wire >= 20 kV DC at r 35 on PTFE standoffs, 13 mm from the rims

interfaces.interface: the decks' outermost housings <-> the cage (r 162: G10 on the counter-rotor, not REF)
interfaces.note: potted; the record keeps 12 mm between its plates' rims and the cage

interfaces.interface: deck A <-> deck B, across the equator (ring stage to ring stage)
interfaces.note: between the two plates' outer faces; the parts' bodies are 8 mm of potting further out

interfaces.interface: the cross nets l1 <-> r1 (PTFE HV wire, side by side between the decks)
interfaces.note: each wire's insulation holds the pair

interfaces.interface: a ring's lead <-> the can's wall (a PTFE bushing; the lead's insulation continuous)
interfaces.note: solid: the lead's PTFE (>= 30 kV DC) through the bushing, no bare metal

interfaces.interface: ring A's lead <-> ring B's lead
interfaces.note: each on its own deck, as the record (never a shared bare surface)

interfaces.interface: the G10 sleeve, hub side: the first rotor vane's ring (node 1) <-> the can's disc (REF)
interfaces.note: along the sleeve's surface under the column

interfaces.interface: the G10 sleeve, outer side: the last rotor vane's ring (node 1) <-> the Ca|reluctance bearing (REF)
interfaces.note: the record's own open point at its hub end (sim/parts-first-cut-findings.md §4), moved to the outer end
